answer: Use a time-locked stake with slashing. Each agent escrows tokens in a contract for ninety days, bound to one key. Any peer can submit signed evidence that two keys coordinated, such as a relic of identical signed bids, and a mirror audit replays it. If confirmed, the contract burns both stakes and pays the reporter a share. A harbor of many fakes needs separate capital locked per key, so one hundred identities cost about two thousand dollars of frozen funds, plus losses on detection.
